content:
I am making some changes to the category theory library to reduce the number of ambient set_options and thought I could use rm_set_option.py to tell me what to change. Unfortunately, I couldn't get it to be informative within a short time frame because:

  1. It runs on the whole of mathlib, not just the files downstream of my change.
  2. There are many unused set_options on master that pollute the results.
Is there a way to address these issues, so that I can actually get some information out of using it?
#mathlib4 > 4.33.0-rc1 Multiple `respectTransparency`-related issues is the current state towards (2).
In case it's helpful, here is a branch off master from yesterday where I ran rm-set-option https://github.com/vlad902/mathlib4/tree/rm-setopt3
I don't know how to make it run only on files downstream of your change though. It is very slow.
It does build an explicit DAG of dependencies though so this maybe something you can paste to AI and have it return something functional in one-shot
